gloss: all talk; lip service; empty words

definitions.gloss: all talk; lip service; empty words
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who says things but never follows through with action, or statements that are not backed by genuine effort or intention. Always carries a negative, critical nuance.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}だけだ。
{口|くち}だけじゃ⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}して→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want you to show it through actions, not just words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{口|くち}だけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる。
examples.english: His promises always end up being nothing but empty words.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: A mere verbal apology won't be forgiven.

notes:
Very common colloquial expression used to criticize someone who talks big but doesn't deliver. Functions as a predicate (口だけだ), a modifier (口だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧人), or part of a larger phrase. The tone is always dismissive or critical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person who is all talk
- {口|くち}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧: empty promise
- {口|くち}だけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる: to end up being just talk
- {口|くち}だけじゃ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: not just words (but action too)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口先|くちさき}→口先：16728_kuchisaki⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: superficial words only — similar meaning, slightly more literary
- {有言不実行|ゆうげんふじっこう}: saying but not doing — four-character compound; formal
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to talk big — emphasizes boasting rather than inaction
